rationale: Cannot freeze enzyme identity without biological/chemical feasibility work. The 'enzyme cocktail' (neprilysin + BACE2 + tau-kinase inhibitor) is currently a HYPOTHESIS, not a design choice.

candidate_enzymes.name: Neprilysin (NEP)
candidate_enzymes.evidence_for: Well-characterized zinc metalloprotease. Recombinant human NEP is commercially available. Decades of literature on Aβ clearance.
candidate_enzymes.evidence_against: NEP is a membrane-bound enzyme. Soluble/recombinant forms have reduced activity. Chronic CSF stability unknown.
candidate_enzymes.key_question: Can recombinant NEP maintain >50% activity after 30 days in synthetic CSF at 37°C?
candidate_enzymes.status: CANDIDATE — requires in vitro stability testing

candidate_enzymes.name: Insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE)
candidate_enzymes.evidence_for: Alternative Aβ-degrading enzyme. Broad substrate specificity.
candidate_enzymes.evidence_against: Less specific than NEP. May degrade unintended substrates in CSF.
candidate_enzymes.key_question: What off-target substrates does IDE degrade in CSF, and are any of them clinically important?

candidate_enzymes.name: BACE2 (beta-site APP-cleaving enzyme 2)
candidate_enzymes.evidence_for: BACE2 (not BACE1) has been reported to cleave APP at a non-amyloidogenic site.
candidate_enzymes.evidence_against: BACE2 physiology is less well understood than BACE1. The 'BACE2 as Aβ-reducing' hypothesis is contested in recent literature.
candidate_enzymes.key_question: Does BACE2 actually reduce Aβ in CSF, or does it have the opposite effect under some conditions?
candidate_enzymes.status: CONTESTED HYPOTHESIS — requires literature review and possibly in vitro confirmation

candidate_enzymes.name: Tau-kinase inhibitor (small molecule, not enzyme)
candidate_enzymes.evidence_against: This is a SMALL MOLECULE, not an enzyme. The original P-04 spec conflated enzyme with inhibitor. A small-molecule inhibitor has very different immobilization chemistry, kinetics, and regulatory pathway.
candidate_enzymes.key_question: Should P-04 include small-molecule tau-kinase inhibition at all? If yes, this is a combination product (device + drug), not just device + biologic.
candidate_enzymes.status: DESIGN CONFLICT — original spec is chemically inconsistent

decision_required: Select ONE primary enzyme (likely NEP based on current evidence). Drop or descoped others. This is a medicinal chemistry decision, not a software decision.
blocking_work_required: Literature review: NEP stability in CSF-like conditions (saline, 37°C, 30+ days)
In vitro test: recombinant NEP activity assay in synthetic CSF
Specificity test: confirm NEP does not degrade unintended CSF proteins
Decision: single-enzyme P-04 (NEP only) vs triple-enzyme (requires 3x more testing)
estimated_time_to_unblock: 3-6 months for single-enzyme path. 12-18 months for triple-enzyme path.
constitutional_basis: Article XXXIV — stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck. The enzyme identity is a biology question. Code cannot answer it.
